item.title: Uber pulls out of Tanzania after long regulatory standoff
item.description: Uber has officially exited Tanzania as of Jan 30, 2026, following a standoff with regulators. The move ends services in Dar es Salaam, Arusha, and Zanzibar.

item.title: Nigeria’s fintech regulators seen as neutral referees, not roadblocks, new CBN report finds
item.description: A new CBN report shows Nigerian fintechs split on regulation, viewing it as neither overly supportive nor restrictive, while highlighting approval delays, compliance costs, and calls for deeper regulator-industry engagement.

item.title: CBN report reveals the top three ways Nigerian fintechs are using AI
item.description: Nigerian fintechs are using AI mainly for fraud detection, customer service automation, and credit scoring, according to the CBN. It also identified some key constraints to scaling AI systems.
